title: Analyzing Code Provenance in LLMs for Programming Education
title_zh: 面向编程教育的 LLM 代码溯源分析

paragraphs.en: 提出扩展 Min-K% 方法的代码溯源分析，用于区分学生原创与 AI 生成代码，发现免费模型检测更敏感。 Large language models (LLMs) play an increasing role in programming education, challenging traditional assessment methods as they can generate fully functional code instantly. This disrupts the reliability of student submissions as indicators of learning and effort. To address this issue, code provenance is essential for tracing the origins of code and distinguishing student-authored, AI-generated, and externally sourced components. We extend the Min-K% probability approach by incorporating synthetic non-member code generation and apply it to Python code for membership inference and provenance tracking. Evaluations cover free LLMs such as GPT-2, DistilGPT-2, and DialoGPT, as well as state-of-the-art commercial models including GPT-5, Gemini 2.5, Mistral, DeepSeek, and LLaMA 3.3. Before evaluating our approach on higher-education student assignments, we validate its feasibility using Stack Overflow data. The results show that free models enable more sensitive code memorization detection than commercial models. By systematically comparing these LLMs, we assess trade-offs between detection accuracy and privacy protection, taking an initial step toward effective assessment of AI-assisted programming education through combined provenance detection and process visibility.
paragraphs.zh: 提出扩展 Min-K% 方法的代码溯源分析，用于区分学生原创与 AI 生成代码，发现免费模型检测更敏感。大语言模型（LLM）在编程教育中发挥着越来越大的作用，因为它们能够即时生成功能完整的代码，这对传统评估方法构成了挑战。 这破坏了将学生提交物作为学习与努力指标的可信度。 为解决这一问题，代码溯源对于追踪代码来源、区分学生原创、AI 生成和外部获取的代码组成部分至关重要。 我们通过引入合成非成员代码生成来扩展 Min-K% 概率方法，并将其应用于 Python 代码以进行成员推断和溯源追踪。 评估涵盖了 GPT-2、DistilGPT-2 和 DialoGPT 等免费大语言模型，以及包括 GPT-5、Gemini 2.5、Mistral、DeepSeek 和 LLaMA 3.3 在内的最先进商业模型。 在高等教育学生作业上评估我们的方法之前，我们使用 Stack Overflow 数据验证了其可行性。 结果表明，与商业模型相比，免费模型能够实现更敏感的代码记忆化检测。 通过系统地比较这些大语言模型，我们评估了检测准确率与隐私保护之间的权衡，为通过结合溯源检测与过程可见性来有效评估 AI 辅助的编程教育迈出了第一步。
